sahneler.metin: NASA's solar-powered Helios broke apart over the Pacific.
Within minutes of hitting turbulence, it fell into the ocean.
It was a huge, light flying wing.
A delayed take-off kept it climbing slowly through rough air.
Turbulence bent the wing sharply upward.
Its pitch swings grew with every cycle until it broke.
The report called for better modelling of flexible aircraft.

aciklama:
Helios broke up and fell into the Pacific. The cause: a flexible wing morphing into a persistent high dihedral, leading to unstable oscillations.
